project.definition: Run a real search teacher, dataset, student, and arena loop on the selected matchup. Improve the working system through measured iterations: establish a runnable baseline, replace flat controls with authoritative visit-based search, train practical students, compare matched compute, and expose honest evidence to Study. As of 2026-07-19 the loop, fail-closed production harness, and world-pinned arena all exist; INT-18 committed the first frozen-cohort production rating, while the exact-range-versus-uniform comparison remains typed evidence_wait and the production visit-teacher iteration remains open. Standing evidence: INT-7 value heads improved calibration while weakening complete players; INT-8 killed one-seed learned priors inside PUCT; learned components re-enter only through arena admission.

krs.text: One documented command freezes replayable trajectories from actual managym games, trains matched policy-only and policy/value students, and plays a seat-balanced arena with pinned dataset, engine, model, seed, latency, throughput, and compute identities.

An authoritative MCTS or PUCT teacher runs the selected matchup at declared budgets, emits legal root visit distributions and values under the acting viewer boundary, and replays every sampled trajectory exactly.

A practical student trains from visit and value targets and then plays the actual matchup; matched-data ablations separate visit-distribution versus chosen-action supervision and policy-only versus policy/value learning.

The world-pinned arena commits its first production rating run over the frozen anchors and the dPUCT-32 challenger, with ratings, the full payoff matrix, connectivity, and paired-deal uncertainty retained; development pairwise matches remain explicitly non-admission.

The fail-closed production visit-teacher harness runs one complete production iteration with multi-seed students after the absent frozen Teacher-0 control bytes are recovered or re-frozen under a versioned contract note; the iteration either improves the admitted agent on the declared strength and competency gates or records an honest failure that determines the next build.

Across multiple seeds, the search teacher is compared with policy-only, scripted, and frozen opponents on legality, competencies, seat-balanced strength, calibration, p50/p95 decision latency, rollout throughput, and label cost, producing an explicit continue, revise, or kill decision.

One historical Study position receives viewer-safe DecisionEvidence from the running policy and search systems, with played Command, policy mass, visits, value, sampled-world robustness, uncertainty, and unavailable fields kept distinct.

task.name: Run the production visit-teacher multi-seed comparison
task.description: Close the two remaining Project KRs with one bounded production experiment, not an infrastructure-only PR. Audit current main and retained artifacts first. The frozen Teacher-0 control digests name absent checkpoint bytes; do not reconstruct, substitute, or mutate the frozen contract in place. Add a versioned contract amendment that trains fresh Teacher-0 controls, freezes exact bytes and identities before comparison, and binds the complete engine, content, ABI, source, seed, and budget closure. Preserve the existing fail-closed INT-4 harness and frozen verification provenance. Run one complete production visit-teacher iteration on the selected matchup with multiple independent training/data seeds, declared teacher budgets, and policy-only, scripted, and frozen controls. Retain exact viewer-safe trajectories, legal offers and semantic Commands, visit distributions, root values or outcomes, opponent identities, manifests, checkpoints, and replay evidence. Report legality, information safety, S1-S5 competencies, seat-balanced strength, calibration, p50/p95 latency, rollout throughput, label cost, sample efficiency, inference latency, total teacher and student compute, matched-compute comparisons, uncertainty across seeds, and an explicit continue, revise, or kill decision. No strength or promotion claim without competency, information-safety, matched-compute, and arena-admission gates. Do not claim the separate exact-range-versus-uniform result, substitute unavailable checkpoints, or relabel INT-7 engineering smoke as production evidence. If the honest production run is infeasible under the hard cap, retain a typed negative result that determines the next build.
